run_stylegan2_training: run a StyleGANv2 training experiment with custom data path and GPU count
build_argparse_parser: build an ArgumentParser with StyleGANv2 training options including dataset and augmentation settings
configure_dataset_options: configure dataset options like data path, class conditioning, and mirror flips for training
set_augmentation_pipeline: set the augmentation mode and pipeline for discriminator training with ADA or fixed probability
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines all StyleGANv2 CLI arguments for training configuration
